Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home

* Only 75 yards to the beach

* Private Pool - (heated additional $50/nt)

* Stunning Gulf Views from Nearly Every Room

* 4 Bikes Included

* Outdoor patio, Grill, and Private Pool

* 1 mile to Rosemary

* Snorkel the Grouper Reef-more info under Area Attractions below

* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service

*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* 

* Fits 2 cars in the driveway. possibly 3 if not large SUV's.

Get ready to embark on an amazing beach escape at Beach Therapy! Nestled perfectly to provide stunning views of the Gulf, refreshing coastal breezes, and sandy shores, prepare yourself for an unforgettable vacation experience. Beach Therapy is a stunning duplex-style home that boasts five bedrooms and five and a half baths, accommodating up to 12 guests. With its exquisite design, adorned with upscale furnishings and flooded with natural sunlight, you'll discover the ideal blend of comfort and luxury.

On the first level, you'll find a fully equipped kitchen and a cozy living area, along with a full bathroom, and 2 sleeper sofas in the common area. The heated and cooled garage has been cleverly transformed into a game room/flex space, perfect for playing ping pong or catching your favorite game on the large flat-screen TV. Ascending to the second floor, you'll be greeted by two master bedrooms, each featuring a king bed, en suite baths, and private porches—ideal retreats for unwinding after a day at the beach. Additionally, there's a bunk room with built-in twin bunks, providing extra sleeping arrangements, along with another full bath. The third floor welcomes you with a seamless open-concept living and dining space, flowing effortlessly onto a covered balcony with breathtaking views of the Gulf. The fully equipped kitchen boasts generous floor-to-ceiling cabinetry, elegant marble countertops, a breakfast bar, a wine refrigerator, and top-of-the-line stainless Thermador appliances. A queen guest room with its own full bath awaits you on this floor, and a spiral staircase leads up to an observation tower—a perfect spot for soaking in stunning sunsets.

Indulge in the private pool, perfect for refreshing morning dips or leisurely afternoons spent on the deck. Surrounded by a walled courtyard, the covered open-air space sets the stage for relaxation and grilling sessions on those nights when you prefer to stay in. With five covered porches, each offering captivating Gulf views, and a tower accessible via stairs from the third-floor balcony, you'll have the best vantage points to soak in the beauty. Just a stone's throw away from fantastic restaurants, shopping spots, and lively entertainment along Scenic Highway 30A, there's no shortage of activities during your visit. Take advantage of the four available bikes to explore the nearby areas of Inlet Beach, Rosemary Beach, Carillon Beach, and Alys Beach—your Beach Therapy awaits!

The Bed Setup:

1st Floor
Guest Suite: Kitchen, living room, and 2 sleeper sofas in the common area

2nd Floor  
Master Bedroom: King Bed  
Master Bedroom: King Bed
Guest Bedroom: twin over twin bunk bed

3rd Floor 
Guest Bedroom: Queen bedroom

Area Attractions: 

Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. 

Enjoy the beautiful sugar white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! 

The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy!
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

description: Located by the sea, this vacation home is in Inlet Beach, a neighborhood in Panama City Beach. The area's natural beauty can be seen at Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, while Frank Brown Park and Shipwreck Island Waterpark are popular area attractions. Emerald Coast Mirror Maze and SkyWheel are also worth visiting. Jet skiing, kayaking, and scuba diving offer great chances to get out on the surrounding water, or you can seek out an adventure with cycling nearby.
